array_order: cls and rho_phys are (nx, ny, nz), element (i, j, k) has centre ((i + 0.5) h, (j + 0.5) h, (k + 0.5) h) in inches

frame.x: horizontal, bracket length, +x outward (from the bolt end towards the clevis end)
frame.y: horizontal, parallel to the clevis pin axis
frame.z: vertical, normal to the mounting face z = 0, +z upward (away from the mounting face)
frame.origin: bottom corner of the allocated box

history_fields: hist_it, hist_J (normalised objective), hist_c (iterations x 4 production compliances, code units), hist_vol, hist_mnd, hist_drho_phys (max |drho_phys|), hist_n_moving (elements with |drho_phys| > 0.01; -1 at iteration 1)
